inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Entry display name.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Validation type: file | text | apk | signature.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File path for file/text checks — a local file on disk or an entry inside the APK (e.g. assets/login.png); disk is tried first, then the APK zip.

inputs.name: md5
inputs.description: Expected MD5 (hex) for file/apk/signature checks. For file checks every available source (local/APK file and URL download) must match it; without it, multiple sources must be mutually identical.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Expected value, or a URL to download as a reference file for file checks.

inputs.name: match
inputs.description: Text match mode: equals | exact | regex | absent.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Property key to extract from a key=value properties file.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: Regex pattern for regex/absent text checks.

inputs.name: apk_path
inputs.description: Resolved APK path — required for apk checks, and used as the zip source when a file/text path is an entry inside the APK.

inputs.name: signature_md5
inputs.description: Signer MD5 fingerprint for signature checks.

outputs.name: passed
outputs.description: Whether the entry passed its check.

outputs.name: actual
outputs.description: Actual value measured from the APK/file.

outputs.name: expected
outputs.description: Expected value the entry should match.

operations.name: validate
operations.description: Validate a single APK validation entry against its declared type and expected value.
